description: Change the three restart/limit lines of a systemd unit. DISTILL-CANARY-fc2e4d63

files.systemd/export.service:
[Unit]
Description=报表导出服务
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/opt/export/bin/export --port 7010
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=4096

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

turns.prompt: systemd/export.service 想让它挂了就一直重启，间隔 10 秒，文件句柄上限提到 65536。ExecStart 那行别动。

systemd/export.service.equals:
[Unit]
Description=报表导出服务
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/opt/export/bin/export --port 7010
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
